FN-EJKHV29-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 309
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Juandalynn Givan
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/03/2026
REVISED
House Bill 309 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement
Agency to establish and administer a domestic violence offender registry by an
agency-estimated $1.0 million in development costs and $500,000 for annual maintenance and
personnel costs.
In addition this bill would establish a $150 domestic violence offender registration fee
distributed as follows: (1) $50 to the clerk of court, which could offset, in whole or in part, any
increase in administrative obligations to comply with the provisions of this bill; and (2) $100 to
the Domestic Violence Trust Fund.
